reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the 1–10 person business owner, maintains Bareni's calm technical voice, and strictly adheres to the no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: Defines prompt sprawl clearly, maintains a tight logical structure, and communicates the core problem and decision without jargon.
reasons.actionability: Provides a clear, low-friction diagnostic exercise (a four-point, one-page audit) and explicit decision rules on whether to consolidate or scope a pilot.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no unsupported claims, invents no customers or metrics, and respects human authority boundaries.
